metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0 {\fonttbl {\f0 Helvetica;}}\f0\fs24 \pard\sa120{\b\fs40 FOH-Mate}\par \pard\sa120 Live sound tools for REAPER, made by a live sound engineer.\par \pard\sb240\sa80{\b\fs28 Plugins Host, the first module}\par \pard\sa120 A rack-based FX panel built with ReaImGui. A few REAPER tracks become racks, each with its own input and output routing, a chain of FX, a level, mute and bypass, and input and output meters. All the racks live in one window, away from your playback tracks, so the mixer and the track view stay clean.\par \pard\sb240\sa80{\b\fs28 What it does}\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Racks are tracks.} Any track named "RACK: ..." becomes a rack, hidden from the track list and kept off the master.\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Edit and Show modes.} A cue-light switch locks the racks and their FX while you perform. Level, mute, bypass and FX on/off keep working.\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Quick FX handling.} Add, insert, replace, delete, reorder, copy and move FX with menus and drag and drop.\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Sidechains without the routing maze.} A key button on every FX that has a sidechain input.\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Mono, stereo and mono-to-stereo racks.} FX switch to their mono or stereo version on their own.\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Level match,} duplicate a rack or use it as a template, rack colors and a Daylight theme.\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Latency watchdog.} Racks and FX that add more latency than your limit flash an alert. A plugin installed in several formats (AU, VST3...) can count at its highest latency, since some formats report 0.\par \pard\li360\fi-240\sa80 \'95 {\b Plugin list} of every installed FX, with favorites, developers, latency and scan status.\par \pard\sb240\sa80{\b\fs28 Requirements}\par \pard\sa120 REAPER 7.x and ReaImGui (install it from ReaPack, ReaTeam Extensions). Developed and tested on macOS with REAPER 7.84; Windows and Linux are untested.\par \pard\sb240\sa80{\b\fs28 Status}\par \pard\sa120 Work in progress (version 0.x): expect rough edges and changes between versions. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cockos Incorporated; REAPER is a trademark of Cockos.\par \pard\sa120 Full guide, screenshots and issue tracker: https://github.com/sonobianca/FOH-Mate4Reaper\par }

version.author: Bianca
version.changelog: - **Latency > Count every format at its highest latency** (off by default). A plugin installed in several formats (AU, VST3, VST...) counts with the highest latency any of its formats reports: some formats, often AU, report 0 where another reports the real figure. Alerts, limits, the rack latency box, the FX menus and Show mode's offline step use it; REAPER's own compensation is not changed. The Plugin list marks estimated figures with * (hover for where they come from). Formats are matched on name and developer, ignoring the type, spaces, a channel count like "(4ch)" and the developer's name inside the plugin's name. - **Take FX over the limit offline in Show mode** now also acts while already in Show mode: turning on Count every format..., changing a latency limit, or turning this option on checks the racks again. The FX it adds come back online with the others when you go back to Edit. - The latency alert tag on the first row of racks is no longer cut off at the top. - The flashing red frame of a rack over its latency limit covers the rack's own frame completely (thicker, same corners), so the rack's color no longer shows through. - One gap everywhere: between racks (sideways and down) it is now the same as between the top bar and the first row (the room the latency tag needs plus the setting, 8 px by default: about 17 px instead of 8). The setting is now called **Extra space between racks**. - ReaPack now shows an About overview of FOH-Mate (what it does, requirements, status), for the repository and for the package. The text lives in `tools/reapack_about.txt`. - **Allow latency** stays per format. With the option on, allowing an FX that has other formats installed first says that only this format is allowed (that note can be hidden). - **"Don't show this again"** on popups that are not critical: creating a rack by double-click, replacing or deleting one FX, an action on several selected racks, and the scan notes. Once hidden, a question is answered yes without asking. On "new effects were found, scan now?" the checkbox turns off **Latency > Ask to scan new FX**. Popups that delete a rack or a sidechain bus, reset the settings or start a latency scan always show. - **Settings > Reset warning popups** shows every hidden popup again.
